question.text: At what range of Hurdle Rates are Indian AIF hurdle rates typically set, per Chapter 6, and how does this compare to international norms?

explanation.text: The Logic: The chapter explicitly states Indian AIF hurdle rates are typically 7-12% p.a. (INR terms), higher than international 5-8% (USD terms). This reflects INR inflation and risk-free-rate differentials. The Trap: A swaps the two ranges — a classic trap. C and D distort both ranges. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same numbers. XIX-B (Cat III distributors) may quote HWM-style performance benchmarks, which are NOT hurdle rates. Manager's Pro-Tip: When benchmarking your AIF's hurdle, also adjust for the LPs' effective tax rate: Cat I/II AIFs pass-through income under Section 115UB, so LPs compare after-tax hurdle. A 10% pre-tax hurdle in an AIF may be roughly comparable to a different headline in a taxable instrument.
